يعتزمون (form VIII)
# يَعْتَزِمُونَ (yaʕtazimūna) /jaʕ.ta.zi.muː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِعْتَزَمَ (iʕtazama)
# يُعْتَزَمُونَ (yuʕtazamūna) /juʕ.ta.za.muː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِعْتَزَمَ (iʕtazama)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
